description:
As an overweight child, Makabe Masamune was mercilessly teased and bullied by one particular girl, Adagaki Aki. Determined to one day exact his revenge upon her, Makabe begins a rigorous regimen of self-improvement and personal transformation. Years later, Masamune re-emerges as a new man. Handsome, popular, with perfect grades and good at sports, Masamune-kun transfers to Aki's school, and is unrecognizable to her. Now, Masamune-kun is ready to confront the girl who bullied him so many years ago and humiliate her at last. But will revenge be as sweet as he thought?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

node.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Aki comes from a well off family and is known for her brutal treatment of men. As a result, she has gained the nickname "Cruel Princess" from her classmates. She allegedly rejected [Masamune-kun](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) and gave him the nickname "Piggy" when the two were children leading to his transformation and commitment to revenge. 

~!It was later revealed though that her hatred towards men is because her childhood crush Masamune left without saying anything which left her heartbroken. When Masamune finally confronts her about the past she tells him that she never gave him the nickname "piggy" in the first place, and never heard of that nickname before. As Aki learns Masamune's identity and situation, she attempts to make him the same chubby boy he used to be. Aki mentions that she found his chubbiness "cute" and overall as a symbol of wealth implying that chubby guys are her type.!~

__Height:__ 178 cm

A narcissistic boy who is obsessed with the idea of getting revenge. His feelings of revenge are aimed towards the popular rich girl, [Adagaki Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki). Despite his handsome appearance now, he was once a chubby kid who people liked to make fun of. 

~!It is shown later on that the reason he hates Adagaki Aki so much was because she rejected his feelings for her and nicknamed him "Piggy". Later on, in order to get revenge on Aki, Makabe teams up with [Koiwai Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino), Aki's maid.!~

She is the younger sister of [Masamune Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) and currently attends middle school as a second year. She does not possess the same surname as her brother due to Masamune's choice of changing from Hayase to Makabe.

Masamune's class rep. She loves Yaoi and likes pairing Masamune to Kojuurou.

~!She confessed her feelings to Masamune once, but got rejected.!~

Yoshino is [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki)'s maid and follower. She seems to be a clumsy girl. However, beneath her clumsy and shy appearance she is actually extremely deceptive and cold, able to deceive and hurt Aki without a second thought. Unlike Aki, Yoshino easily gained weight from sweets.

~!Later it was revealed that Yoshino had disguised herself as Aki eight years before, rejected Masamune, and gave him the nickname "Piggy" due to jealously towards Aki's affection to him, but soon realized that her actions caused Aki to become estrange towards men. She has been regretting this and attempted to repay what she has done after Aki and Masamune reunited in high school.!~

~!She later falls in love with Makabe Masamune.!~

Kaneko Sonoka is one of the girls who have self-proclaimed themselves as [Aki Adagaki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/)'s bodyguards and the Vice President of Yasaka High School Student Council.

Kaneko is a cute and fairly short girl. She has dirty-blonde hair that has two pink ribbons tying up two straps of her hair into ring-shaped like while the rest of her hair reaches her chest and pink eyes. She wears the Yasaka High School uniform which consists of a pink shirt, black vest with the school symbol on it, a striped yellow skirt and a blue and yellow ribbon.

**Height:** 155 cm

Masamune's best friend who looks like a girl, but is actually a boy. ~!He has a small crush on Neko.!~

**Height:** 159 cm

Neko Fujinomiya is a cute and cheerful rich girl who transferred school after [Masamune Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) "gave her his coat on Christmas Eve" and fell in love with him. She has a frail body, needing to consume many drugs although she often makes jokes about it. Due to her habit of not wearing any panties, [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino) nicknamed her "Pantie-less Woman".

~!While claiming that she just needs Masamune to pretend that their first encounter were real, Neko is actually genuinely in love with Masamune when he's still chubby, although it is never revealed how. After Masamune rejected her, Neko's condition got worse and she underwent a surgery abroad, and then came back with better health and thus continue to support Masamune.!~

__Height:__ 138 cm
__Occupation:__ Housewife

She has light brown hair that curls at the tips and brown eyes. She wears a headband that has a dog footprint on and she usually is seen wearing an apron. She is very short, has a small body, and can be easily mistaken for a child, even though she is 42 years old. She is also the mother of Makabe Masamune.

__Gender:__ ~!Female!~ 

~!Kanetsugu Gasou is a daughter of a family which used to be rich. She was one of Aki's love interests. Kanetsugu pretends to be Aki's childhood friend "Masamune" to gain funding for her little sister and home.!~
Midori Yuisaki is one of Aki Adagaki's maids.
